The pipes are full of hot steam and there's no insulation around them. One touch and you will be scalded. I have taught you the ratio to mix the protective coating liquid and water, so be careful. It doesn't matter if you waste some coating liquid, just don't add too much water! The pipes' surface temperature is very high, so if you brush a very watery liquid onto it, the room will fill with water vapor. If something goes wrong, it can be fatal. As for how to apply the coating, you already know this. Brush it thinly and evenly, don't go back and forth. The eighth point goes over the most important thing — maintenance of the steam turbine rotor. Halfway through the maintenance, be sure to check your maintenance clothes' electrical insulation and protective goggles. Also, when going back for maintenance, please remember to stop the boiler and generator. This is a delicate device and if it breaks, there's no replacing it for a while. You can't be too careful with it. For the tenth point, the alarms and monitoring devices we use now are different from the ones in the manual. Just go with what I taught you. That's about it. Once the heating maintenance is complete, you'll be a full-fledged maintenance worker. Come by during the Solwarm Festival and I'll treat you to a special suncake. ◆ Finality's Vision ◆
● Through the Finality's Vision feature, Trailblazers can participate in events before meeting their prerequisite conditions in advance.
● Since you would be experiencing the events in advance, this feature may impact your story and gameplay experience to some extent. Please use this feature at your discretion.

◆ Requirements ◆
● When your Trailblaze Level is at <unbreak>21</unbreak> or above, should the event support Finality's Vision, you can access said event through the Travel Log function.
● If you have already activated the Finality's Vision feature within the event's active period, you can continue to experience it in advance even after it is included in Conventional Memoir.
● Trailblazers can start multiple events via Finality's Vision at the same time, but only one can be activated to experience its content at any given time.

◆ Event Missions ◆
● After activating Finality's Vision, all event prerequisites will be waived, and you will be allowed to directly take on the corresponding event mission.
● If a mission's prerequisite mission was itself unlocked and completed via Finality's Vision, and the prerequisite conditions for that prerequisite mission have not yet been met, that prerequisite mission will still be considered as not having reached a fully completed state. Therefore, its subsequent missions will still indicate that they need to be unlocked via Finality's Vision. After completing the prerequisite conditions for a prerequisite mission, it will be considered as being in a fully completed state. This same logic applies if even earlier prerequisites were also completed via Finality's Vision.
● When switching to track another mission accepted via Finality's Vision, it will automatically switch to that mission's Finality's Vision state.

◆ Event Map ◆
● After activating Finality's Vision, you will temporarily be able to explore the maps related to the unlocked game mode, including maps yet to be unlocked through the main story's progression.
● In temporarily accessed maps via Finality's Vision, you can only experience the content essential to the current event.
● If you switch your navigation to another mission accepted via Finality's Vision, the temporary map for the current Finality's Vision will close and become inaccessible until the respective mission relating to said map is reactivated.

◆ Closing Conditions ◆
● The event will officially unlock once Trailblazers have completed all prerequisite conditions. The Finality's Vision status for the corresponding mission will be removed, and access to the temporary map will also be disabled.
● If the event content has not been fully completed, you can inherit your progress when you officially unlock the event.
